description.translate: Eight pieces of glass will restore the reading alcove's windows. A quiet place to consider a difficult record is sometimes more useful than another answer spoken too quickly. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

At The Ranker's Memorial, both relics may be awakened together. Finish all twelve promises yourself. Lay the sword and ring together on the Blood Altar and fill it three times. The altar takes ten thousand LP with each offering. Give your own blood with the Sacrificial Knife during the third fill. Ysra's lesson still applies: friends may help, but that personal choice cannot be made for you.
